name: denominations
title: Denominations
description: What a unit of value IS: its code, what kind of thing it is, and how finely it divides. Amounts everywhere are stored as an integer count of the smallest unit (150000 USD minor = 1,500.00; 5000000 BTC minor = 0.05 BTC), and this collection is what tells the system where the decimal point goes -- see object_money.py. That is the generalization of this codebase's founding 'money is integer cents' rule: cents were always USD minor units. A business holds value in more than one denomination at once -- a bank balance, bitcoin, a stablecoin, a box of cash, gift cards, possibly a weight of metal -- and they divide differently (JPY has no minor unit at all; ETH has eighteen places). Kept as DATA rather than a code table so an operator can add a gift-card program, a loyalty point, or a barter unit without a deploy. Reconciled against a private predecessor-system audit (not part of this repo): its Currency model carried the same fiat/crypto/metal/commodity split and a per-currency decimal_places, but stored every amount in one fixed 8-decimal column -- a schema that could declare more precision than it could hold. Integer minor units have neither failure: exact by construction, no ceiling, no rounding dust on ordinary dollars.

fields.name: code
fields.label: Code
fields.help: USD, JPY, BTC, USDC, XAU, or your own (GIFT-ACME, POINTS). Compared case-insensitively.

fields.name: symbol
fields.label: Symbol
fields.help: Optional display prefix ($, EUR). Purely cosmetic -- the code is the identity.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.help: What class of thing this is. Drives valuation and tax treatment later (crypto disposals are lot-tracked in most jurisdictions; metals are often taxed as collectibles), and nothing today.

fields.name: scale
fields.label: Decimal Places
fields.help: How many decimal places the unit divides into: 2 for USD, 0 for JPY, 8 for BTC (satoshis), 18 for ETH, 4 for a troy ounce of gold by convention. Amounts are stored as integers of the smallest unit, so this is what makes 150000 mean 1,500.00 rather than 150,000.

fields.name: is_system
fields.label: Built-in
fields.help: Seeded denominations everyone shares. Operator-defined ones (a gift-card program, a loyalty point) are ordinary rows.
